prompt:
This is a Japanese business document (invoice 請求書 / quotation 見積書 / delivery note 納品書). Extract the fields below.

IMPORTANT — extract every value EXACTLY as printed on the page (verbatim). Do NOT normalize, reformat, translate, round, or compute anything:
- Keep dates in their original on-page form (e.g. 2026年3月31日 — never rewrite to 2026-03-31).
- Keep numbers with their original digits and separators as shown.
- Only return a value that is literally printed on the document; never sum, infer, or derive a number (such as a subtotal/total) that is not actually shown.
- Return an empty string for anything not present.

Verbatim values let the engine anchor each value to its exact spot on the page; reformatted values cannot be located precisely.

columns.name: vendor
columns.description: Issuing company (発行元) — the company that issued/sent this document; usually the side with the seal/stamp. Copy the name verbatim.

columns.name: recipient
columns.description: Addressed-to party (宛先, marked 御中) — the company this document is billed/sent to. Copy verbatim.

columns.name: invoice_no
columns.description: Document number (請求書番号 / 見積番号 / 納品書番号), exactly as printed

columns.name: invoice_date
columns.description: Issue date (発行日) exactly as printed, e.g. 2026年3月15日 — do not reformat

columns.name: due_date
columns.description: Payment due date (支払期限) / valid-until (有効期限) exactly as printed; empty if absent

columns.name: items
columns.description: Line items, one element per printed row

columns.name: subtotal
columns.description: Subtotal (小計) exactly as printed; empty if not shown as a single value

columns.name: tax
columns.description: Tax (消費税) exactly as printed; empty if not shown as a single value

columns.name: total
columns.description: Grand total (合計金額) exactly as printed
